data.label: Octaves
data.note:
OpenSimplex Noise again at each octave, its scale growing by
Lacunarity and its weight shrinking by Roughness, combined
as the type does.

data.label: Multifractal
data.note: Their product: each scales what's there by 1 ± its weight.

data.label: Hybrid Multifractal
data.note:
Each octave weighted by the ones before (times Gain, at most 1),
stopping once that weight is negligible.

data.label: Heterogeneous Terrain
data.note:
The first octave plus Offset, then each octave scaled by the
height so far: smooth lowlands, rough peaks.

data.label: Ridged Multifractal
data.note:
Ridges where the noise crosses zero, (Offset − |noise|)², each octave
weighted by the last one's ridge (times Gain, within [0, 1]).

data.label: Normalize
data.note: fBm's sum into [0, 1] by the weights' total, when normalized.
